selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How did the believers answer Allah’s kindness and care shown through His blessings?
questions.answer: They answered with gratitude and praise.

questions.question: What main idea is shown by saying that all praise belongs to Allah?
questions.answer: It shows that every blessing truly comes from Him and that He deserves all thanks.

questions.question: According to the passage, what in the universe points to praising and thanking Allah?
questions.answer: The blessings spread throughout creation and the signs found in them point to His praise.

questions.question: How do the blessings on the earth act like witnesses to Allah’s generosity?
questions.answer: Their abundance, order, and benefit show His giving and kindness.

questions.question: What do the fruits of mercy and provision do in front of people who see them?
questions.answer: They testify to Allah’s generosity and offer thanks to Him by what they are and how they are made.

questions.question: Why does the speaker say people cannot thank Allah as fully as He deserves?
questions.answer: Because His favors are so many and so great that human thanks can never fully match them.

questions.question: What quality of Allah is highlighted by the many blessings placed across the world?
questions.answer: His generosity and mercy.

questions.question: What does the passage teach a Muslim to notice when seeing blessings in daily life?
questions.answer: A Muslim should notice Allah’s care, thank Him, and remember that the blessing is a sign of His mercy.

questions.question: What was the believers’ response after seeing signs of mercy and compassion in Allah’s gifts?
questions.answer: They responded by praising Him and thanking Him.

questions.question: In this passage, who is being thanked for the blessings of the world?
questions.answer: Allah, the true giver of blessings.

questions.question: Why are the blessings described as spread across the universe and over the earth?
questions.answer: To show that Allah’s favors are everywhere and are too many to count.

questions.question: What do the blessings themselves seem to do, according to the passage?
questions.answer: They seem to declare Allah’s praise and call attention to His greatness as the giver.

questions.question: How do orderly and balanced fruits support the message of the passage?
questions.answer: Their careful design shows mercy, provision, and wisdom, so they point people to thank Allah.

questions.question: How does this passage connect nature with worship?
questions.answer: It shows that what people see in creation should lead them to remember Allah and worship Him with gratitude.

questions.question: What attitude should an 8th-grade Muslim student take from this passage?
questions.answer: A student should have a thankful heart, notice Allah’s gifts, and praise Him for them.

questions.question: What is the best short summary of the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s blessings everywhere show His mercy and generosity, so people should praise and thank Him.

questions.question: What two actions are joined together in the believers’ response in this passage?
questions.answer: Thankfulness and praise.

questions.question: Why is Allah described as the real giver in the passage?
questions.answer: Because every favor and blessing comes from Him in truth.

questions.question: What does the passage say the blessings of the universe are doing by their very existence?
questions.answer: They are showing Allah’s worthiness of praise and thanks.

questions.question: How do blessings in the world act like a message to people?
questions.answer: They tell people that Allah is merciful, generous, and worthy of gratitude.

questions.question: What can be understood from the mention of well-shaped and orderly fruits?
questions.answer: That Allah’s giving is not random but full of wisdom, care, and beauty.

questions.question: Why does the passage focus on both mercy and generosity?
questions.answer: Because blessings are not only useful gifts but also signs of Allah’s loving care and openhanded giving.

questions.question: What is the main lesson of the passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: Everything good around us should lead us to recognize Allah’s mercy and thank Him.

questions.question: What should a Muslim student remember after reading this passage?
questions.answer: Every blessing is from Allah, and the right response is sincere praise and thankfulness.

title: Reality of Prayer Responding to the Creator's Acts with Knowledge Love and Gratitude
